edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. Previous attempts to tighten conditions or add improvement bonuses with small caps failed. This revision restructures the reward: (1) Makes controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated (+20, fires once when first entering near-pad region with main engine use). (2) Makes touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot event-gated (+30, fires once when both legs contact near pad with low velocities). (3) Adds a strong distance improvement bonus (+1.0 per unit distance decrease, capped at +1.0 per step) to provide a clear gradient toward the pad. (4) Keeps distance penalty at -0.05 to avoid early termination. (5) Removes repeatable positive bonuses to prevent farming. The one-shot bonuses are larger than previous failed attempts (+20 and +30 vs +10 and +20) to provide stronger incentive to reach the pad. The distance improvement bonus cap is +1.0 per step (vs previous failed +0.5) to provide a stronger gradient without dominating.
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
progress_shaping distance penalty scale (-0.05) kept moderate to avoid early termination
changed_design: Make controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated: +20.0 bonus fires once when the lander first enters the near-pad region (distance<0.5) with main engine use (m_power>0) and upright (|angle|<0.2). Track with self._controlled_descent_given flag.

Make touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot event-gated: +30.0 bonus fires once when both legs contact near the pad (distance<0.5) with low velocities (|vy|<0.5, |vx|<0.5) and small angle (|angle|<0.2). Track with self._touchdown_stability_given flag.

Add distance_improvement_bonus: +1.0 * (prev_distance - current_distance) when distance decreases, capped at +1.0 per step. This provides a strong, continuous incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start via hasattr check.
Remove the repeatable controlled_descent_bonus (was +0.5 per step) and repeatable touchdown_stability_bonus (was +10 per step) to prevent farming.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses repeatable without phase conditioning: now one-shot event-gated.
Do not tighten distance conditions without providing a strong gradient: added distance_improvement_bonus with +1.0 cap.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: bonuses are now one-shot and conditioned on progress.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we keep it moderate and add improvement bonus.
Do not make one-shot bonuses too small to motivate approach (previous failed patterns used +5, +10): this revision uses +20 and +30.
Do not cap improvement bonus too low (previous failed patterns used +0.5): this revision uses +1.0 cap to provide stronger gradient.
Do not increase distance penalty too aggressively (previous failed pattern used -0.1): this revision keeps -0.05.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The distance improvement bonus will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The one-shot bonuses provide clear milestones that require approaching the pad, which should increase main engine use (action 2) during descent.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_improvement_bonus (+1.0 per unit distance decrease, capped at +1.0 per step) provides a strong gradient to move toward the pad. Distance penalty (-0.05 * distance) provides additional mild incentive. Phase 2 (descent): one-shot controlled_descent_bonus (+20) fires when first entering near-pad region with main engine use, providing a milestone signal. Phase 3 (touchdown): one-shot touchdown_stability_bonus (+30) fires when both legs contact near the pad with low velocities, providing a milestone signal. Success bonus (+100) provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: distance_improvement_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it naturally diminishes as the lander approaches the pad and cannot be farmed indefinitely. controlled_descent_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
